title: Impover Mod
description: Improve Mood is a mod that lets you manipulate the world. Toggle mobs on and off. Manage the world to the fullest!
body:
# Imrover mod — Complete control over the world!


**Impover mod** — is an ambitious project created for those who find Minecraft's default settings insufficient. This mod expands the possibilities for generating and managing gameplay, allowing you to customize every aspect of your adventure.


### ⚠️ Development stage: BETA
The mod is currently in active beta testing. I'm constantly working on adding new features. Currently, the main focus is on entity (mob) management.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
!!!
Some features may be unstable. I'd appreciate your feedback in the comments or on GitHub!

</details>

> 
## 🛠 What can be configured now?

**The current version offers extensive mob spawn customization. You can:**

- Completely disable or enable the spawning of specific creatures.
- Choose which mobs will populate your world right when creating a new game.
- Regulate the population through in-game commands without restarting the server.


## 💻 Command Interface (In-Game Commands)
**You can change world settings on the fly with simple and clear commands.**
**How does this work:**
With this command you can instantly disable any entity in the world:
```
/impover config [mob] false
```
Well, with the inclusion it's similar:

```
/impover config [mob] true
```

# 🚀 Plans for the future
**I'm just getting started! Coming soon:**
- Setting up weather and day length.
- Managing the density of structures (villages, dungeons).
- Changing biomes and their boundaries.
